questions.originalHtml:
The transmission of the nerve impulse across a synapse is accomplished by the release of a neurotransmitter

Explain the related idea

Summarize the events involved in impulse transmission from the presynaptic neuron to the postsynaptic neuron.

Textbook p. 380
